name: GitHub Copilot
tagline: AI coding assistant inside your editor and on GitHub
description: GitHub Copilot is an AI coding assistant with inline suggestions, chat, an agent mode and a command-line tool, sold in Free, Pro, Pro+ and Max plans plus business offerings.
features: Copilot in the cloud: assign work and create pull requests (paid plans)
Delegation to third-party agents (preview, Pro+ and Max)
strengths: Paid plans have unlimited inline suggestions
Extra usage can be bought as AI credits (1 credit = $0.01)
limitations: Free plan is limited to 2,000 inline suggestions per month and entry-level models
Business and Enterprise pricing is not shown on the page

plans.name: Pro
highlights: $15 of total AI credits per month ($10 base + $5 flex)

plans.name: Pro+
highlights: $70 of total AI credits per month

plans.name: Max
highlights: $200 of total AI credits per month

free.details: Limited chat and agent usage, 2,000 inline suggestions per month, entry-level models, agent mode and CLI.

api.summary: Extra usage beyond included credits is available through a flex allotment or by buying credits; 1 AI credit = $0.01 USD. Budget alerts trigger at 75%, 90% and 100%.

notes: Business and Enterprise pricing: contact sales (not shown on the page).
